articles.summary: Landmark transaction marks Genesis Capital’s first securitization backed entirely by multifamily loans originated and serviced by the firm Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM, “Rithm” or the “Company”), a global alternative asset manager, today announced the closing of NRMLT 2026-RTL1, a $375 million securitization backed entirely by multifamily loans originated and serviced by its subsidiary, Genesis Capital, LLC (“Genesis” or “Genesis Capital”). The transaction represents both Genesis's first multifamily-only securitization and the largest multifamily-only residential transition loan (“RTL”) securitization completed to date. The transaction builds on significant growth in Genesis’s multifamily loan business. Quarterly multifamily loan originations nearly quadrupled, increasing from approximately $160 million in the first quarter of 2024 to $637 million in the second quarter of 2026, and multifamily loans now represent approximately 40% of the platform’s outstanding commitments. articles.summary: Rithm Capital Corp. In addition, management will host a conference call that same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. A copy of the earnings release will be posted to the Shareholders – Events Presentations section of the Company’s website, www.rithmcap.com . The webcast of the conference call may be accessed at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/976436235 . In addition, participants are encouraged to pre-register for the conference call at https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/976436235?pwd=0lyfjeVL . articles.summary: Advances Rithm’s Expansion of Asset Management Platform Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM) (“Rithm”), a global alternative asset manager, today announced the closing of a joint venture with a fund managed by DRA Advisors LLC (“DRA”) for the ownership of 1301 Avenue of the Americas, one of the flagship assets in the New York City office portfolio of Elecor Properties (“Elecor”), Rithm’s real estate operating platform. Rithm, through Elecor, will continue to hold majority ownership of the asset and operate the building on behalf of the joint venture. articles.title: Rithm Capital and DRA Advisors Announce Joint Venture for Ownership of 1301 Avenue of the Americas
